Advanced Primary Treatment 	6 Includes primary sedimentation with coagulation and flocculation using anionic polymer and ferric chloride, and surface skimming.
Primary effluent is pumped via ten Archimedes screw type pumps with a total capacity of over 1,000 MGD to the secondary reactors via the Intermediate Pumping Station (IPS).
Secondary Treatment 	6 Includes activated sludge biological treatment using high purity oxygen and secondary clarification.

The secondary process is comprised of nine reactor modules each with a design capacity of 50 MGD, a cryogenic facility to produce high purity oxygen, 36 circular clarifiers each with a design capacity of about 30 MGD, and a Return Activated Sludge (RAS) pumping system.

The Permittee plans to construct a permanent pump station for the 1-Mile Outfall Surge Chamber.

HAWPF will process up to 2 MGD primary treated effluent through fine screening, membrane bioreactor (MBR), reverse osmosis (RO), and UV disinfection/advanced oxidation process (UV/AOP) to produce 1.5 MGD of advanced treated recycled water.
